name: 2.0.0-test-rc19 focused checklist
description: Focused checks for bounded Optimize controls, permanent suggestion catalogs, and release health.

items.name: Optimize sliders and exact values stay synchronized
items.description: Test: Create an Optimize plan, move each budget, token, duration, and quality slider, then enter exact values in the boxes. Save, reopen, and restart the instance. Pass: Each slider and number show the same value, values stay inside the displayed limits, all six settings persist, and controls fit on desktop and phone without horizontal scrolling.

items.name: Optimize suggestions cover common planning goals
items.description: Test: Open Optimize > Suggested, confirm eight items are available, and filter for agent, workflow, cost, tokens, speed, and quality. Use one agent and one workflow item, then edit them. Pass: Filters find relevant items, Use creates an editable plan, automatic model selection is visible where proposed, and saving never changes an agent model or workflow schedule by itself.

items.name: Authorized private suggestion catalogs are complete
items.description: Test: In the authorized private image, open Guardrails > Suggested and Evals > Suggested, then search and filter representative agent and workflow items across safety, privacy, security, correctness, speed, and cost. Pass: Each catalog shows fifteen distinct usable suggestions, Evals cover both agents and workflows, details are readable, and using one creates an editable workspace item.

items.name: RC19 identity, plugin boundaries, mobile layout, and restart
items.description: Test: Start the exact RC19 public image and authorized private image, check /api/health, /api/system, and the plugin sidebar on desktop and phone, then restart. Pass: Version is 2.0.0-test-rc19, health is HTTP 200, only intended plugins appear in each image, Review and Optimize remain usable on phone, and workspace plus plugin state survive restart.
